authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/teenage/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/teenage/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the guide's table of incoming MIDI control changes, with its printed name, sent as that controller. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

The mixer rows answer on the channels of the four mixer tracks (`1 - 4 *`); the rest on any. A synth and a drum sound share controllers 46 - 53: the guide names both, and the profile both in one name.
Left out, the sustain pedal, the wheel and the channel mode messages: CC 64 sustain pedal, CC 123 all notes off.
